acquisition method: data dependent mode with synchronous precursor selection (SPS)-MS3 analysis
The Orbitrap Fusion (Thermo Scientific) was operated in positive ion data dependent mode with synchronous precursor selection (SPS)-MS3 analysis for reporter ion quantitation.
alkylation reagent: followed by 5 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) alkylation in the dark for another 30 min.
alkylation concentration: followed by 5 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) alkylation in the dark for another 30 min.
cleavage agent: Lysyl endopeptidase (Wako) at 1:100 (w/w) was added and digestion continued overnight. Trypsin (Promega) was then added at 1:50 (w/w) and digestion was carried out for another 12 h.
collision energy: 35% normalized collision energy (MS2), 65% normalized collision energy (MS3)

collision-induced dissociation (CID)-MS2 fragmentation in the linear ion trap with 35% normalized collision energy... after higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 65%.
fragmentation method: collision-induced dissociation (CID)-MS2 fragmentation... after higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation
instrument: LC-MS platforms consisted of a Dionex RSLCnano UPLC coupled to an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer
ionization type: coupled to an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer with a Flex nano-electrospray ion source (ThermoFisher).
labeling: Utilizing Tandem Mass Tag (TMT) isobaric labeling
reduction reagent: Samples were reduced with 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) at room temperature for 30 min
reduction concentration: Samples were reduced with 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) at room temperature for 30 min
